info.title: NutriScan AI API
info.description:
Backend for **NutriScan AI** — an AI food nutrition scanner and nutrition chatbot for students living in
hostels or on their own.

* **Scan** a food photo: a transfer-learned classifier (ViT fine-tuned on Food-101) gives hints, Gemini vision
  identifies every item and estimates portions and nutrients, and the backend computes totals and a
  deterministic health score.
* **Chat** with NutriBuddy (Gemini, text + images, function calling over your own data).
* **Track** daily intake, trends and daily insights.

Every response uses the envelope `{success, code, message, data}`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer
<token>` from `/auth/register` or `/auth/login`. *Estimates only — not medical advice.*

post.description: Exchange email + password for a bearer token.
Creates a throw-away guest account (`user.is_guest = true`) and returns a 7-day bearer token, so people who don't sign up still get real AI scans, chat and suggestions. Limited to 30 per hour per IP.

post.description: Multipart upload. Pipeline: validate & normalise image → transfer-learned classifier hints (ViT/Food-101) → Gemini vision per-item analysis → server-side totals → deterministic health score and flags (+ Gemini tips). `meal_type` defaults from the user's local time. Non-food images return `422 NOT_FOOD` (the rejected scan is stored; its id is in `details.scan_id`).

patch.description: Apply edits in order. `{id, quantity_g}` rescales nutrients linearly; `{id, name}` renames and re-estimates that item (Gemini text); `{id, remove: true}` removes; `{name, quantity_g?}` without an id adds a new item (Gemini text). Totals, score and flags are recomputed; tips are kept (regenerate with `POST /scans/{id}/tips`).

post.description: Same multipart input. Responds with `text/event-stream` events: `user_message` (ChatMessage), `tool` ({name, summary}) per tool call, `delta` ({text}) chunks, then `done` (final saved ChatMessage) or `error` ({code, message}). Validation errors (empty message, bad image, unknown session) are returned as normal JSON envelopes before the stream starts. Use fetch + ReadableStream (EventSource can't POST multipart).
